text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Almond Eye! It's Almond Eye after 
all! Reaching the Senior class, she shines 
even brighter! This year is truly her 
one-woman show once agaaain!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Uwooooah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Child
text_block_list.text:
Ai-chaaan! Ai-ch... Ai-chan! 
Congratulatiooooons!!"å»

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What do you think! —I won, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Maaan, Almond Eye is seriously insane! I 
mean, we can totally say it out loud now, 
right...?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"—Almond Eye is the strongest in the 
country right now! Just maybe, she might 
really pull it off...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O's undefeated year was about 
to be recreated in this era—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Your soul is guiding you here! Eye-kun... 
In other words, you—"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: "Aiii~~~~! Congrats!!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"You were so strong! Ai, you really are 
incredible!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Blast...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ai is just sooo reaaallly cool...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Wow... You're so tall! I bet your running 
is amazing too...!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, want to race with me? I'd love to 
challenge you!”

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ai always confronts me 
straightforwardly... heart to heart. I 
love her so much!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo is gonna get super strong so I can 
race against Ai again!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Let's compete as many times as it 
takes!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ah... Huh? ...That's weird...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I should have won, without a doubt. I 
mapped out every conceivable scenario...

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, it was all torn apart. Like a 
scrap of paper, in an instant—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Almond Eye~~~!!" "Eye-chaaan!" "Come back 
to Hanshin again~!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...What's this about defeating them? What 
do you mean... "I'm not the 
protagonist"...?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Isn't Ai-chan... the true protagonist?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, my Carmen!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san!? Why are you all the way 
over—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to invite me, didn't you? I 
understand completely!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Eye-kun. You truly 
are—exceptionally strong!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The way she left everyone else in the 
dust— she was like an absolute conqueror.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let me ask you, Ai-kun. You're the same 
way after all, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Yearning to follow my footsteps, to 
surpass them— you will walk the royal 
road, achieving both the Spring and Autumn 
Senior Triple Crowns, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: No!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Like hell you aren't!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I know how great your legacy is. But my 
heart is already set on my next race!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—The "Victoria Mile." What do you think, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Why at this timing of all times?"—the 
words almost slipped out. Almond Eye had 
begun walking the mixed-category royal 
road with the Japan Cup and Osaka Hai.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—It's a race many girls on the Tiara route 
choose—so to speak, it carries the strong 
colors of that route. I can understand why 
you'd feel bewildered.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Still, I... I have someone I want to race 
against! Her, now that she's grown even 
stronger than before...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes! What I've been searching for all 
along— I think it's who she is right now!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hahahahaa!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"To carry on the conversation while 
ignoring this Overlord... As expected of 
an Umamusume I acknowledge!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In other words, what you mean is this, 
yes? —You will run wherever your heart 
leads you.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
“—I must applaud you! To think you could 
lead even me astray!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Um... thank you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are not the king. Quite simply— you 
are a challenger.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Then the Overlord is needed no longer! I 
shall take my leave."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"For the rest, seek my words in this 
year's daily tear-off calendar of me."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...'Praise Me Day,' 'Brainstorming an 
Opera Script with Me Day.'
choice_data_list: Every single day is packed full...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It was the same last year, but we really 
seem to cross paths with unexpected 
people, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...About earlier. You seemed surprised 
too, so I suppose my choice really isn't 
the normal one."
choice_data_list: Still, that choice is just so like you.
Still, that choice is just so like you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. ...As long as you understand, then 
it's fine!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Winning the Victoria Mile. ――That is my 
path!"
